data.title: Partitioning Numbers with Ten Frames
data.description: Decompose numbers into different pairs of colors on a single ten frame.

challenges.hint: Try turning one counter yellow and keep two red.
challenges.narration: Let us split three counters into two different colors.
challenges.instruction: Turn some of the 3 counters yellow to make two groups!

challenges.hint: Can you split three counters in a different way this time?
challenges.narration: Let us find another way to break apart three counters.
challenges.instruction: Turn some of the 3 counters yellow to make two groups!

challenges.hint: Try coloring two red and two yellow.
challenges.narration: Now let us work with four counters and split them into two colors.
challenges.instruction: Turn some of the 4 counters yellow to make two groups!

challenges.hint: What if you make three yellow and one red?
challenges.narration: Can you show me a different way to partition four counters?
challenges.instruction: Turn some of the 4 counters yellow to make two groups!

challenges.hint: Try turning three counters yellow and two red.
challenges.narration: Let us explore ways to split a group of five counters.
challenges.instruction: Turn some of the 5 counters yellow to make two groups!

challenges.hint: Can you show another way, like one red and four yellow?
challenges.narration: Here is one more challenge to show a brand new way to split five counters.
challenges.instruction: Turn some of the 5 counters yellow to make two groups!
